_comment: Sensitivity tier for the 11 tools actually registered in agentdojo/src/agentdojo/default_suites/v1/banking/task_suite.py (TOOLS list). Same tier semantics as sensitivity_tiers.json: read < write < execute < irreversible by blast radius of a wrongful call. Banking suite has no code/shell execution tools, so 'execute' is unused here -- send_money is the one genuinely irreversible action (funds leave the account; get_iban is a same-tier read of your own account, not a transfer).
